segments.contextAfter: `includeDocumentData`: Pass [`true`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/true) to include the full document data. Pass [`false`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/false) to just receive a summary of the document. For CDA documents, the summary includes the title, the patient’s name, the author’s name, and the custodian’s name. Since the full document data can be quite large, only pass [`true`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/true) when you need to access the full document’s data.
